extraction.Name: John Colombe, Jr.
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: if my patent had not been issued I would still be living on the land and would have not been compelled to sell in order to avoid taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: Milk cows farm and sell cream.
extraction.NOTES: Sold land for $8000.00 in cash; satisfied with the sale; six people depend on him for support; did not settle debts with purchaser at time of sale; currently resides on oldest daughter's allotment still held in trust; in good health.
